d:
After such a long time, Maka realesed another tankoubon!
I kinda been retired but this marvelous work of art demands a translations!!

Anyway, since there's almost no censorship in this book, I went ahead and removed the tiny bit that was left, just from the lolis, though.
Yep, I'm lazy xD

Also, as Maka likes transparent bubbles and writing over his drawings, it's a pain to clean and redraw so it takes longer to edit the pages so I'll try to publish one chapter per week but I can't promise eanything.

Lastly, please support the artist!
